about: A person's decisions about which Mulberry symbol a Word Sounds word gets. They win over dev-tools/build_word_sounds_symbols.cjs. After a change run: node dev-tools/build_word_sounds_symbols.cjs
how: Add the word under "words". To use a symbol: {"status": "reviewed", "file": "name.svg"} (the file must be one of the word's candidates in data/word_sounds_symbols_map_en.json; leave "file" out to approve the one the script chose). To use none: {"status": "rejected"}. An optional "note" says why. A decision on a word also holds for its plain plural.
